title.zh-CN: 跨时代人物：源头、传述与后世接收
title.en: Cross-era figures: source, transmission and later reception

question.zh-CN: 老子、孔子与释迦牟尼如何在不同时间、空间、文本和后世制度中被理解？
question.en: How are Laozi, Confucius and Śākyamuni understood across different times, places, texts and later institutions?

disclaimer.zh-CN: 这是基于当前关系与来源的比较阅读，不把三位人物、三种传统或不同证据层压缩成同一历史事实。
disclaimer.en: This is a comparison built from the current relations and sources; it does not collapse three figures, three traditions or different evidence layers into one historical fact.

description.zh-CN: 区分历史记录、传统叙事、神圣化和后世文学再现。
description.en: Separates historical documentation, traditional accounts, sacralisation and later literary representation.

description.zh-CN: 显示主传统、次级关联、证据层和来源，而不预设价值排序。
description.en: Shows primary and secondary affiliations with evidence layers and sources, without implying a value hierarchy.

description.zh-CN: 把人物源头时间与传统日期、文本传述和后世接受时间分开。
description.en: Keeps source-period claims distinct from traditional dates, textual transmission and later-reception periods.

description.zh-CN: 追踪言说、段落、文本和说话者归属之间的证据链。
description.en: Traces the evidence chain among sayings, passages, texts and speaker attribution.

description.zh-CN: 列出活动地点、制度空间、路线节点和记忆地点，并保留空间角色。
description.en: Lists activity sites, institutional spaces, route nodes and memory sites while retaining spatial roles.

description.zh-CN: 区分人物参与的事件与后世把人物接入的分析性事件。
description.en: Separates events in which a figure participates from analytical events that later connect the figure to a context.

description.zh-CN: 把经典、版本、段落、注释和后世接收分别显示。
description.en: Keeps classics, versions, passages, commentary and later reception distinct.

description.zh-CN: 展示制度化、再解释、纪念、神圣化和文学再现，而不把它们倒写为人物当时的事实。
description.en: Shows institutionalisation, reinterpretation, memory, sacralisation and literary representation without projecting them back as contemporaneous facts.

description.zh-CN: 每一格都能回到来源、定位和证据等级；未记录不等于不存在。
description.en: Each cell can return to sources, locators and evidence grades; not recorded does not mean non-existent.

title.zh-CN: Public RC 人物：人物、空间、时间与文本入口
title.en: Public RC figures: people, place, time and textual gateways

question.zh-CN: 玄奘、司马承祯与孔颖达如何在同一座城市中进入不同的传统与制度关系？
question.en: How do Xuanzang, Sima Chengzhen and Kong Yingda enter different traditions and institutional relations in one city?

disclaimer.zh-CN: 这是当前 Public RC 已审核人物的并置阅读，不把三位人物、三种传统或不同证据层压缩成同一历史事实。
disclaimer.en: This places the currently reviewed Public RC figures side by side; it does not collapse three people, traditions or evidence layers into one historical fact.

description.zh-CN: 区分文献记录与仍需展开的研究边界。
description.en: Separates documented claims from research boundaries that remain open.

description.zh-CN: 显示主传统、证据层和来源，而不预设价值排序。
description.en: Shows primary traditions, evidence layers and sources without implying a value hierarchy.

description.zh-CN: 把人物年代与关系事件的时间边界分开。
description.en: Keeps biographical periods distinct from relation-event boundaries.

description.zh-CN: 显示长安活动锚点及其空间角色。
description.en: Shows Chang'an activity anchors and their spatial roles.

description.zh-CN: 把人物、经典、版本和原典入口保持为不同层。
description.en: Keeps figures, classics, versions and passage gateways as distinct layers.

description.zh-CN: 每一格都能回到来源、定位和证据等级。
description.en: Each cell returns to sources, locators and evidence grades.
